scope: Prior bounded array/table/module subset plus string-list load/query and variable-category lookup

contracts.implemented: Distinct empty list object, scope selection, pinned text load, CR/LF/CRLF lines. No double-slash filter or percent-marker conversion.

First name match, first equals separator, no trimming, empty value uses query defaults. ASCII case fold only. A non-ASCII name encountered before a match stops with a resource byte reference; all rows remain stored and classified.
contracts.nameCount: Distinct ASCII names in the bounded model
contracts.unresolvedNameCount: Number of non-ASCII name rows, not guessed equivalent names

contracts.implemented: Found value uses a zero-default integer-cache candidate, unlike table numeric fallback. Outside reviewed numeric range/syntax stops. Missing/empty value uses saved defaults.
Bare variable name lookup returns current local/global/system category 3/2/1 or missing 0 in global ResultInt. ResultStr is preserved.
unsupported: native ABI and complete state flags

contracts.implemented: For l, try catalog logical directory of current pinned script, then literal logical name. Different-byte variants still need explicit selection, even if a later candidate is unique.

unchanged_limits: Scalar, array, catalog, expression, table and snapshot limits remain as in prior profiles and current source
